title: Uesugi Shrine

buildingCutout.basis: Mapped worship hall with projection toward the courtyard.

terrainReference.basis: Original GSI bare-earth ground on the stone approach between the main hall and courtyard entrance.

mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap building and fence geometry, named shrine and torii points, and native GSI elevation. January 2024 photographs show the courtyard gate, torii and worship-hall frontage.

note: The worship hall has a broad gray-green hipped roof with raised corners and a high ridge, dark natural timber framing and open central bays. The entrance is much lower and links the timber enclosure. The stone torii has two inward-sloping pillars and a curved upper lintel.
